messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — CardioLeap wants a short APAC allowlist + rate bump for a pilot starting tomorrow. Onboarding shows low baseline but partner demo could spike traffic. Renewal in ~42 days, so this pilot is high priority. Can SRE pin traffic to ap-northeast and allow CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 for 72h? Need QPS 250 with burst 400. Customer id CL-4821.

Ben (Acct Exec): FYI — I just had renewal call, they're worried about SG latency. If we can show stable low-latency during the demo it helps closing. I'll join the demo.

Arjun (SRE): Can you confirm exact client IPs / headers? Do they authenticate from fixed NAT IPs or use partner proxies? Also prefer we do region pin (route policy) + allowlist. I can do ephemeral rule.

Maya (CS): Staging proxy IPs: 203.0.113.5, 203.0.113.6. Partner endpoint 198.51.100.42. They may rotate inside the /24, so CIDR 203.0.113.0/24 preferred. Window: 2026-04-02T08:00Z -> 2026-04-05T08:00Z (72h). QPS 250, burst 400. We'll provide bearer token header X-Client-Token from their staging env.

Lina (Solutions): Also recommend enabling prefix/KV cache warmup for the demo and a short prompt-set warmup. I'll drop a small harness to warm KV cache 1h before start.

Arjun (SRE): Sounds good. I'll do canary in ap-northeast-1 then roll global for that account. Need a short config payload to apply.

Arjun (SRE): ```json
{
  "customer_id":"CL-4821",
  "region_pin":"ap-northeast-1",
  "allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.42/32"],
  "rate_limits":{"qps":250,"burst":400},
  "start":"2026-04-02T08:00:00Z",
  "end":"2026-04-05T08:00:00Z",
  "notes":"72h ephemeral bump for partner demo; auto-revoke"
}
```

Maya (CS): Perfect. Also capture renewal flag: if pilot latency < 120ms p95 and errors < 0.5% for 24h, team to propose a 12‑month commitment discount. Ben to own pricing.

infra-bot: Applying canary routing rule now (canary window 10m). Requestor: Arjun. Ticket: CS-7021.

Arjun (SRE): Canary applied at 6172839572. Running quick smoke.

Arjun (SRE): Canary looks clean — rolling to full for CL-4821 in ap-northeast-1. Full apply complete at 6172839670.

Maya (CS): Great :tada: I'll notify CardioLeap, log the demo window, and set follow-up in CRM. Ben — can you prepare the renewal playbook / pricing offer? Lina — please send warmup artifacts and test harness link.

Ben (Acct Exec): On it. Will add a conditional offer draft to the renewal folder.

Lina (Solutions): Warmup script and prompt set uploaded to /shared/cs/warmups/CL-4821. I'll trigger warmup 1h before start.

Maya (CS): Closing loop. Thanks all — keeping this ephemeral so it auto-reverts after 72h.
